_about: Fixture table for tools/test-opsec-guard.mjs. Every row is run through G.opsecGuard.screen() inside the real built page.
expect is the exact set of finding codes the row must produce ([] = must come back clean).
excerpt (optional) must appear in one finding's excerpt, proving the finding points at the right text.
Date tokens are filled from the real clock so no row ever depends on a particular year:
{{SOON_*}} = tomorrow, {{FAR_*}} = about 13 months out, {{PAST_*}} = about 6 weeks ago.
Every string the audit of the first guard quoted is in here, on the side it belongs.

cases.name: AR 380-5 board question (three levels, mixed case)
cases.text: What are the three levels of classified information? Top Secret, Secret, and Confidential (AR 380-5).

cases.name: restricted report is confidential
cases.text: A restricted report is confidential and does not trigger an investigation (AR 600-52).

cases.name: clearance levels by MOS
cases.text: A 35F requires a Top Secret clearance; a 92A requires a Secret clearance.
